pages.title: Narrow AI Core
pages.text: An artificial intelligence that is superhuman at one task and useless at everything else. It can design an efficient coil in an instant but would not recognise a cup of tea. The core is a smooth dark block that warms when it is busy, which is often.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I connected a Neural Lattice to a Quantum Processor in the Neural Synthesizer and trained it on a single problem. Within an hour it beat my best design. It still could not answer any question I asked outside that problem.
